summary: MetaVia Inc. filed an 8-K on 2026-11-05 furnishing a press release (Exhibit 99.1) announcing positive interim data from Part 3B of its Phase 1 trial of DA-1726, a dual GLP-1/glucagon oxyntomodulin analog, and attaching an updated corporate presentation (Exhibit 99.2) under Item 8.01. The filing is a Regulation FD disclosure of clinical and investor-communication materials, not a transaction. No stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or closing date is stated. No structural or deal mechanics apply; the only item to watch is the clinical data readout's effect on sentiment, not arbitrage.
